{{Quote|This is wonderful! It's been ages since I've had a decent lightsaber workout. You know how to activate one. I hope you can handle it well enough to put up something of a fight|[[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]] to [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gregar Typho/Legends|Gregar Typho]]|<ref name="CNII:SOS" />}}
Following the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]]-after being freed from the mines of [[Oovo IV/Legends|Oovo 4]] by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] to find [[Jax Pavan]]-kept two [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] on her person: a [[Color/Legends|red]] [[Aurra Sing's lightsaber|lightsaber]] and a '''green''' one. Though she preferred to use her red lightsaber, she would keep a green lightsaber on her belt as well. She used the green blade to duel [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gregar Typho/Legends|Gregar Typho]] in the ruins of the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] after the captain took her red lightsaber. Typho was barely able to defeat the infamous bounty hunter by striking her skull implant, however, Sing survived. She proceeded to use the green lightsaber, the red one having been taken by Typho in his escape. In the Holo House at a [[Coruscanti/Legends|Coruscant]] fun fair in the lower levels, she used the green weapon to fight the [[Gray Paladin]] [[Laranth Tarak]]. The [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] Paladin proved more than a match for Aurra, despite using only two [[DL-44 heavy blaster pistol/Legends|DL-44s]], with her aim penetrating the bounty hunter's deadly defence and singeing on Sing's left shoulder. Tarak also punched the bounty hunter and almost shot her face at point blank, which Sing was barely able to avoid by arching backward, though not without recieveing a four-by-one-centimeter sunburn on her upper left cheek. Sing winded up drawing her own [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] in her off hand to try and counteract Laranth's rain of fire, however, after one missed shot the Paladin disappeared. Following their brief duel in the Holo House, Sing resorted to stalking Tarak to find Pavan. Aurra Sing later used the lightsaber again in her duel with Jax Pavan, her initial strike grievously wounding Laranth Tarak, with Sing attempting to go in for one last killing blow on her, which Jax parried with Aurra's crimson lightsaber which he had been gifted. During the entire fight Jax was kept on the backpedal, only able to survive Sing's never ending tirade of attacks with the assistance of the Force. Eventually, realizing he couldn't beat Sing through skill alone, he lured her onto a fabber, specifically onto a safety field above a bin churning sand, and when Aurra landed on the field, Jax hit the button to deactivate it, causing Aurra to fall into the swirling sand. The bounty hunter made a strike in the sand, but it only fused it to glass. She quickly lost grip on her emerald lightsaber and was swallowed up.<ref name="CNII:SOS" />
